After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

Jodie has landed in Bali and Diags is over the moon. Elma says she's happy for them, but will seeing them together be harder than she thought?

Jack asks his estranged father for help in looking after Andie - who insists she travel to Providence immediately. Meanwhile, budding director Dawson studies for his film class. James Van Der Beek and Katie Holmes star

Prue and Phoebe break the rules of magic to save Piper from a life-threatening illness - a rash move that results in another six people catching the disease and a fearsome ninja doll being brought to life. To complicate matters further, Leo returns to Earth determined to fight Dan for Piper's love
Stephen Mulhern hosts as Ush tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize
Rylan Clark hosts a revival of the supermarket-based game show in which three pairs of shoppers go wild in the aisles to win a £3,000 prize

With the gang heading back to Essex, Dan doesn't want the party to end and sets up a group chat inviting his gang on a big night out to keep the Bali flame alight.
The clock is ticking as Karen examines what really caused her car accident, and Jassi hosts an event for her boyfriend Darius

p.t: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
p.d: The fangs are out at the Viper Room as tensions run high between Kyle and Dorit, and Sutton and Garcelle plan a cheesy surprise.

Stephen Mulhern hosts another charity edition of the game show, with Kadeena Cox, Adam James and Ellie Taylor trying to guess the familiar phrases hidden in animated clues. After the first elimination, the two remaining players battle to reach the Super Catchphrase round, where one of them could win £50,000 for the good cause of their choice

Graham Norton hosts the game show as operations manager Emma, partnerships manager Ebona and consultant Dan compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes, with a potential jackpot of £50,000

Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000?
Highlights of the latest 24 hours in the house before hosts AJ Odudu and Will Best announce the first housemate to face eviction in front of a live audience

Peter learns about phone apps and his newly acquired enthusiasm soon sees his phone overloaded. He buys a new mobile with greater memory and gives his old one to Chris, which sets in motion a series of horrible events leading to his son being branded a sex offender and sent on a rehab course

Brian and Stewie are accidentally locked inside a bank vault for a weekend in the 150th episode of the popular adult animation, and their situation goes from bad to worse when Brian reveals his plans for the future

First-ever episode of the popular crime drama, starring John Thaw as author Colin Dexter's Oxford detective who treats his cases as intellectual challenges. In this mystery, Morse is introduced to trusty Sergeant Lewis (Kevin Whately) and takes it upon himself to investigate the apparent suicide of a lady friend. Co-starring Gemma Jones, Patrick Troughton, James Grout and Peter Woodthorpe

Colonel and Joan Maltravers host a dinner party to celebrate their son's return from Kenya but the meal is disrupted by an armed robbery. David gives chase to the thief and becomes a local hero - much to the exasperation of Bernie. Liz has a difficult decision to make after receiving an exciting offer from Ben. Guest starring Simon Williams, his wife Lucy Fleming and their son Tam Williams

The police investigate the murder of an ex-army recluse and archaeological enthusiast and suspect a building dispute could provide a motive, while Dennis asks Liz for advice when he begins to notice a change in Jenny's behaviour. Vernon decides to play Cupid on behalf of his relative Gareth and sets him up on a blind date with Rosie, but does not count on the mechanic having another admirer. Rural drama starring Duncan Bell, Aislin McGuckin and Vanessa Hehir

A family hunting expedition ends in a youngster's tragic death, and Ken clashes with Harper over the hospital laundry. Meanwhile, staff at the Royal persuade a devout Catholic mother to be sterilised - much to the disgust of her priest. Drama, starring Robert Daws, Linda Armstrong and Michael Starke

An anxious Danny tries to make sure everything is in order for the conservation authority's annual visit to Leopard's Den - but his preparations are ruined when he discovers Fatani has been draining the reserve's watering hole for building work. Du Plessis refuses to resolve an old grievance with the inspector, while Rosie and Max go in search of stolen elephant calf Togo. Stephen Tompkinson stars
Nathan's inquiries clear Zak of being the poacher. Mark warns Faye to stay away from Home Farm, and Nathan continues to manipulate Katie and Lee.
Nathan continues to goad Lee about where Katie's affections lie, leading to a heated confrontation. Sam receives good news and the Dingles are worried by Zak's disappearance.
Deirdre finally stands up to Peter and refuses to leave Simon with him. Julie fears she might be pregnant, but Kirk is delighted at the prospect, while Tom apologises to Maria.
Deirdre threatens to call social services about Peter's drinking. Dev asks Minnie to pretend to be an art dealer, and Molly's plans irritate Sally.

Merton investigates the murder of a retired policeman who was about to flee the village for Spain and, after visiting the victim's widow, discovers the man kept more than a few secrets from his wife. Vernon decides to arrange a poker night in the hope it will make him easy money, but doesn't count on playing against a hustler. Rural drama starring Duncan Bell, Geoffrey Hughes and Mark Jordon

First of a two-part storyline. Jenny's life starts to spiral out of control and begins to affect her work, leaving Dennis and Liz facing difficult decisions. New doctor Helen Trent arrives in Aidensfield with her wealthy husband Matt, hoping to make a fresh start, but finds it hard to adjust to the slow pace of life in the country. Sophie Ward joins the regular cast, including Sarah Tansey, Duncan Bell and Aislin McGuckin

The surgery is chaotic, with both Martin and Louisa now practising from it. Bert's new business venture with Al doesn't get off to a good start, and Penhale suspects noise complaints are due to paranormal activity. Drama, starring Martin Clunes as a surgeon who is forced to retrain as a GP and takes up a post in a sleepy Cornish village, where he soon finds himself at odds with the locals

Morwenna is back as receptionist and the Ellinghams have a new dog. Martin attends Stewart's survival course, but not as a participant like Al and Penhale. Louisa agrees to help Pippa by speaking at the school assembly alongside Mrs Tishell. Drama, starring Martin Clunes as a surgeon who is forced to retrain as a GP and takes up a post in a sleepy Cornish village where he soon finds himself at odds with the locals

The wounded officers arrive at Downton and Matthew suggests he bring General Sir Herbert Strutt to inspect the new convalescent home - but Branson decides to spoil the visit after failing his army medical. Meanwhile, William's return results in an awkward surprise for Daisy, and Violet and Rosamund discover Lavinia's past misdeeds. Costume drama, starring Dan Stevens, Allen Leech, Thomas Howes, Maggie Smith and Zoe Boyle

Having realised her marriage is a mistake, Rachel is still staying at Janet's and making excuses for her absence, but Sean isn't prepared to accept that things have gone so wrong, so quickly. Meanwhile, the investigation into Joe Bevan continues as the body count rises and the team faces the mammoth task of identifying the victims and determining the order in which they were murdered. Detective drama, starring Suranne Jones, Lesley Sharp and Sean Maguire

The trio pose as domestic staff to protect the life of a former dictator. Inevitably, domestic duties give way to dangerous circumstances. Fantasy drama, starring William Gaunt, Alexandra Bastedo and Stuart Damon

The Flying Squad trails diamond thief Jimmy Fleet on the inside, with Carter acting undercover as a fellow prisoner aiming to gain his confidence. On his release for lack of evidence, Fleet seeks Carter's assistance after discovering his girlfriend has vanished with the jewels, suspecting she has been abducted. Michael Elphick guest stars

Bodie and Doyle are trained to act as bodyguards to a Middle Eastern president who is preparing to sign an important peace treaty. Meanwhile, two killers are receiving similar training to prepare them to assassinate him. As their paths cross, the CI5 operatives learn the would-be killers have some useful inside information and share more in common with them than they may have imagined
The team is enlisted to track down a mystery plane responsible for destroying an American aircraft. Fantasy drama, starring William Gaunt, Alexandra Bastedo and Stuart Damon
Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz take their nephew on his first pick and visit the 1890s home that once belonged to an opera singer
Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz visit a theme park during a clear-out and later discover some shocking news about a collection of circus posters

Guest stars Eric Morecambe and Ernie Wise are entrusted to guard a consignment of heart pills by the girlfriend of the eminent research chemist developing the medicine. Before long, the comedy duo find themselves pursued by Middle Eastern operatives intent on procuring the new drug, as well as Sweeney officers who are trying to protect them. With John Thaw and Dennis Waterman

Bodie and Doyle's country holiday with their latest girlfriends spirals into chaos when they are held hostage in a farmhouse by two gunmen who have just botched a robbery. Adventure, with Gordon Jackson, Lewis Collins and Martin Shaw

Gabbie Partington presents coverage of night two from AFAS Live in Amsterdam, featuring the concluding first-round matches, played over the best of 11 legs. Luke Littler was runner-up to Michael van Gerwen last year and he got his tournament under way with a 6-4 victory over Simon Whitlock. Also at this stage 12 months ago, home favourite Raymond van Barneveld overturned a 5-3 deficit and survived six missed match darts from compatriot Cor Dekker to win 6-5. Gerwyn Price and Jonny Clayton were also among the victors, overcoming American qualifiers Danny Lauby and Jason Brandon respectively. With analysis from Glen Durrant and Chris Mason

Hard-hitting action from the world of All Elite Wrestling - the roster features world-class talent including Jon Moxley and Claudio Castagnoli, and many more who bring a freshness and energy into professional wrestling
Part one of two. The story of Brian Pillman, who clawed his way to infamy with a ground-breaking performance that blurred the lines between fact and fiction
The team is enlisted to track down a mystery plane responsible for destroying an American aircraft. Fantasy drama, starring William Gaunt, Alexandra Bastedo and Stuart Damon
Charlie is introduced to the fiancee of Angie's adult son, and faces a dilemma when he realises he has met her before. Comedy, starring Charlie Sheen, Jon Cryer and Angus T Jones
Charlie bumps into an old flame and begins to wonder if he could be the father of her son. Charlie Sheen and Jon Cryer star
Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection

An American tourist and her daughter take a holiday in Italy, only to get caught up in a disaster when Mount Vesuvius unexpectedly erupts. Her husband is a former special forces commando, and he gathers his old comrades in arms to join him on a rescue mission. Disaster movie, starring Adrian Paul and Jhey Castles

Part two of two. The Abyss joins forces with the Nietzschean fleets and descends on the Andromeda, as the crew prepares for the final battle. Last-ever episode of the sci-fi series, starring Kevin Sorbo and Lisa Ryder

A teenager whose home was destroyed by an unusual tornado grows up to be an amateur storm chaser, and investigates when similar freak storms start occurring across the world. He enlists the aid of a meteorologist in getting to the truth, and discovers the strange weather is cover for an alien invasion. Sci-fi thriller, starring Kari Wuhrer and Jeff Fahey

A senator asks Walker to stop a criminal who has infiltrated the federal law enforcement's computer systems. Chuck Norris stars

A team of mercenaries are sent after two escaped dinosaurs, only to make the unwelcome discovery that the creatures are just as smart as humans. Action adventure, starring Michael Pare, Linnea Quigley and Ramiro Leal

A mismatched group of travellers fight for survival in an unexplored area of the Amazon jungle
The team tries to prevent an insane Soviet general starting World War Three. Action adventure, starring Mr T and George Peppard

A New York cop in debt to loan sharks persuades his foster brother and fellow police officer to rob a train carrying all the day's takings from the city's subway network. However, things start to go wrong when a female detective creates rivalry between the pair, and a pyromaniac serial killer threatens their plans. Action comedy, starring Woody Harrelson, Wesley Snipes, Jennifer Lopez and Chris Cooper

Former special forces soldier Snake Plissken is sentenced to life on Manhattan Island, an anarchic penal colony for the most dangerous criminals. When Air Force One is hijacked and crashes there, Snake is coerced into rescuing the US president from prisoners holding him hostage. John Carpenter's sci-fi action adventure, with Kurt Russell, Donald Pleasence, Lee Van Cleef, Adrienne Barbeau and Isaac Hayes

p.t: We Still Steal the Old Way
p.d: After their exploits in We Still Kill the Old Way, criminal outfit the Archer Gang encounters an old enemy when a daring heist ends with them behind bars, however that doesn't stop them attempting to break out an old friend. Prison drama, starring Ian Ogilvy, Billy Murray, Julian Glover and Lysette Anthony
Bo and Luke take a driving job and Jesse tries his hand at gambling. Wheel-spinning adventures, starring John Schneider and Tom Wopat
As Earth prepares to close down the station, Bester tries to persuade Sheridan to return to the Shadow homeworld
Odysseus and his men journey home after conquering the city of Troy, but they face perils from beyond their natural realm. Fantasy, starring Dylan Vox, Lara Heller and Hachem Hicham
Take a look at all the latest movies and series coming your way this month

When the owner of a southern cotton plantation is drafted into the army during the Second World War, he is unable to curb his arrogance and clashes with his sadistic captain, who makes it his mission to reform the private's wayward attitude. Drama, starring Robert Wagner, Terry Moore, Broderick Crawford and Buddy Ebsen

Two hot-headed brothers set off to find the wreckage of an aircraft in the Alps - one intending to loot it, the other determined to stop him. But when they finally reach their goal, there's a surprise in store that forces the feuding siblings to deal with their differences once and for all. Drama, starring Spencer Tracy and Robert Wagner
A strange virus causes Kirk, Scotty and Dr McCoy to age rapidly, and it seems their days are numbered unless they can find a cure. Sci-fi adventure, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy
Two men rob the Hazzard Bank, while Sheriff Coltrane, Deputy Enos and the Dukes are quarantined. Fast-paced adventure, starring Tom Wopat and John Schneider
A news reporter visits the station, there is bad news for Sheridan, and Dr Franklin battles to save the telepaths. Sci-fi adventure, starring Bruce Boxleitner
A karate student joins a gang to avenge those responsible for shooting his brother, and Walker attempts to restore order to the neighbourhood before Christmas

Fact-based drama covering the events of the first major battle in of the Vietnam War. A veteran colonel is placed in charge of an elite combat division, which is assigned to protect a landing area. They find themselves surrounded by overwhelming enemy forces, but are determined to fight to the last man. Starring Mel Gibson and Madeleine Stowe

A hard-drinking San Francisco cop investigates the case of a man murdered with an ice-pick, but his normally well-honed intuition starts letting him down as he falls for the sultry and manipulative chief suspect, the victim's former girlfriend. Thriller from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Sharon Stone, Michael Douglas, George Dzundza and Jeanne Tripplehorn

A selfish investment banker is given an unusual birthday present by his free-spirited younger brother. He is enrolled in a mysterious game, the nature of which is never revealed - and as he tries to fathom the rules, his life rapidly begins to unravel in explosive fashion. David Fincher's thriller, starring Michael Douglas, Sean Penn, Deborah Kara Unger and Peter Donat
Buying goods from the comfort of home
The first destination is the Masons Arms in Meysey Hampton, Gloucestershire, where guests try cold-water swimming, before struggling with a disturbed night's sleep
The rival hoteliers arrive at Wards Hotel in Folkestone, where hosts Dill and Darsy have high expectations to meet after revealing their extensive industry experience day one

The contestants stay at the Queens Arms in Berkshire, where horse racing enthusiasts Ben and Freddie treat their rivals to an afternoon of riding at nearby Newbury racecourse - only for an uncomfortable night and cleanliness complaints to cause the scores to tumble at feedback time

The final visit of the week is to Midshires Way Campsite in East Leake, Nottinghamshire, run by Brendon and Vicky. The guests love their lodges and are big fans of the finishing touches, though Dill and Darsy aren't sure about the value for money. The B&Bers enjoy a relaxing boat ride in the afternoon, but are not so relaxed the following morning when they have to cook their own breakfasts

The rival hoteliers to air their grievances on payment day. Greg and Vicki from the Masons Arms want to know why two of their guests lost sleep, while the team from Wards Hotel has a score to settle with Freddie and Ben of the Queens Arms

The first of the week's dinner parties in Medway, Kent, is hosted by experimental cook and retired grandmother Nina Gaskell. Her guests are barmaid Laura Leibo, police worker Esther Kennedy, mortgage adviser Michael Dodsworth and art graduate Patrick Fysh, and she hopes to impress them with her unusual dishes including a cucumber stuffed with corned beef, and gravy with coconut

Barmaid Laura Leibo hosts the second party in Medway, Kent, but struggles to cope with the stresses of the task. She hopes her improvised cheesecake and questionable gravy will be forgotten when she invites her guests to take part in a robotic dance-off in her kitchen - with Nina Gaskell grabbing the opportunity to show off a hidden talent

Police communications officer Esther Kennedy hosts the third dinner party in Medway, Kent. She has very high standards and believes everything has to be just so, with nice cutlery, matching plates and impeccable glassware. But the key thing is her gourmet menu, which may or may not prove a hit with her fellow diners. However, Esther does end the night by treating her guests to an impromptu rock performance

Actor Patrick Fysh hosts the fourth dinner party in Kent, and hopes to impress with his molecular gastronomy. However, Michael Dodsworth is confused by the 21-year-old's interest in surrealist feminist art, and Nina Gaskell is left speechless by risque pictures of his girlfriend

Michael Dodsworth hosts the final dinner party in Medway, Kent, and decides to keep his menu simple by preparing Thai chicken cakes, jambalaya and raspberry and lime sorbet. He also arranges games including pinata, before the winner of the £1,000 prize is announced

The contest begins at One4 B&B in Cheltenham, where debonair art-dealing host Nick Purchase hopes to prove his that his establishment offers the best value for money. However, things get off to a less-than-ideal start when a life-drawing class leaves one of his guests in a fit of nervous giggles

The competition moves to the Windy Bottom B&B in Maidstone, Kent, where owners Gloria Barnett and Dave Goulding try to impress their guests with a trip to Leeds Castle. However, a proprietor manages to offend one of her rivals, and another is not impressed at being allocated a Versace-themed room

The third visit is to the Jolly Carter pub in Bolton, Greater Manchester, run by Phil and Angie Sutcliffe. Despite a few nerves about the accommodation not measuring up, the room inspections go well, but the guests' verdict on the afternoon's roller disco remains to be seen

John Humberstone hosts at the 18-room Alexandra Hotel in Llandudno, where he hopes the scaffolding on the outside of his establishment will not ruin his chances. However, when one of the guests gets locked in a bathroom and there is a slip-up with towels and teabags, it seems he has plenty of other things to worry about

The competition moves to the Windy Bottom B&B in Maidstone, Kent, where owners Gloria Barnett and Dave Goulding try to impress their guests with a trip to Leeds Castle. However, a proprietor manages to offend one of her rivals, and another is not impressed at being allocated a Versace-themed room

The third visit is to the Jolly Carter pub in Bolton, Greater Manchester, run by Phil and Angie Sutcliffe. Despite a few nerves about the accommodation not measuring up, the room inspections go well, but the guests' verdict on the afternoon's roller disco remains to be seen

John Humberstone hosts at the 18-room Alexandra Hotel in Llandudno, where he hopes the scaffolding on the outside of his establishment will not ruin his chances. However, when one of the guests gets locked in a bathroom and there is a slip-up with towels and teabags, it seems he has plenty of other things to worry about

The contestants featured on the show reunite to revisit the highs and lows of their various stays, and as the B&B owners confront their critics face to face, they discover what the rival parties really thought of the quality of service that they encountered. After the deliberations are over, the winning guest house is announced

Fuzz Townshend and Tim Shaw continue their mission to seek out and rescue classic cars for deserving owners. In Cambridgeshire, they take on Kev's Toyota MR2 Mk1, a two-seater sports car with more than its fair share of automotive issues
After Jass got Lillian's name tattooed on her, she discovered her pictures were fake and that her name is really Kayla! Nev and Kamie find out who she's really been talking to
The theft of a horse and the reward money paid out to recover the animal are at the heart of a case between a woman and her contractor.
Allegedly armed with an axe in one hand and a shovel in the other, a woman is accused of attacking a young man's car while he was learning how to drive a stick shift car on her street.
A struggling single mother is sued by her estranged father for the return of child support that he claims she fraudulently collected.
A woman spurned by her lover on her birthday, an incriminating voice recording, and over $12,000 in 'jealousy' vandalism to a Mercedes are disputed.

Cole returns to town and contacts Phoebe, but she does not want to see him. Meanwhile, Prue is kidnapped by an evil priestess and forced to marry a warlock named Zile. Supernatural drama, starring Shannen Doherty and Julian McMahon

Prue embarks on a desperate journey through time to the mid-19th century, hoping to save Phoebe and a Native American from death at the hands of a frontier thug. Shannen Doherty, Alyssa Milano and Holly Marie Combs star
Mike meets his online partner Caroline for the first time. She has continually avoided face-to-face contact until this point
A bloody fight between a LAPD police woman's pit bulls and a smaller adopted mutt is disputed; both parties insist they were in control of their pets at the time of the altercation
A man's beloved entertainment system, second only to his child, is allegedly stolen by his ex-live in lover; she accuses him of two-timing and welfare fraud.
Severe chest contusions and a fractured jaw are the injuries a woman initially felt she suffered after tripping and falling at a party; the homeowner claims she just wants his money
Two young boys steal a little girl's toy car and damage it beyond repair; the little girl's mother is accused of chasing the boys down in a car and cursing at them.

As the sisters prepare for Leo and Piper's wedding, Prue begins to experience vivid dreams about a seedy bar and a biker. Later, she is arrested for murder, and it is up to Cole, Darryl and Leo to solve the mystery before the stroke of midnight

Two demons set their sights on killing Cole's landlady and police officer Andrea, leading the sisters into a confrontation with the Angel of Death himself as he sets about adding the victims' souls to his collection. However, a surprise is in store for Prue, who is given a new appreciation of life by the experience

The Wildlife SOS team rescue a giant python from a busy train depot, treat the wounds of a rescued tiger, and persuade an injured elephant to take a jacuzzi

Michelle heads to Anchorage, where she checks on orphaned moose calves before they are released back into the wild, stopping to help a reindeer with a broken antler on her journey to the city. Plus, the vet works with Dr Riley from the Alaska Zoo on an arctic fox with a mysterious lump, as well as a coyote that needs to be neutered and a porcupine with bad teeth

Michelle tries to treat three young bison in Alaska that need de-worming before they can be sent back into the wild, but the herd begins to spook and stampede - and the vet has to decide whether to abort the mission. Elsewhere, a group of wild horses becomes a traffic hazard, and a scandal rocks a family farm when female rabbits locked inside a pen all become pregnant
It's raining baby giraffes, Dr Priya gives Connie the elephant an eye exam, and two camel brothers embark on a new life
The Okavango flood turns desert into a wildlife haven, drawing elephants and predators before the waters vanish once more
The Boteti River is a vital dry-season pitstop for migrating animals. But one year, the river unexpectedly stops flowing, and the wildlife is forced to adapt
Every October, shark attacks double in Hawaii. Join scientists as they investigate what is behind Sharktober
In the depths of winter, Margot hits the trapping trail on the hunt for precious fur-bearing resources. Billy tries his hand at building a hot water heating system
A terror attack is suspected when a plane explodes after taking off from New York. The FBI joins NTSB investigators, but the case pits them against each other

Judy finds her inner hero on the Rangers Camping trip as they need to shelter from the weather; Paddington befriends a speedy snail with a heroic future ahead, but also looks so sad.
Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.
Paddington seeks the mystery hero doing good deeds, Paddington gets stuck in an igloo.

Paddington tries to find out who his favourite hero is, so he sets out with Judy. Paddington really wants to participate in a skating competition, but he can't. Until Mateo gives him a helping hand with a magical mask.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Holly and Ben help the Wise Old Elf play a trick on Nanny Plum for Elf Joke Day, but she does not see the funny side and gets her revenge by turning the Wise Old Elf into a giant snail.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.

p.t: Thomas And Friends: All Engines Go
p.d: Thomas and Nia's light play comes to James' rescue in the dark.
Paddington and Simi go on a magical journey into the human body.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.

It's World Book Day, and Paddington helps Mateo discover his favourite character. Paddington, Simi, and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt on the island in the park, but they are unsure if dinosaurs still exist.

When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.

When Gabby unboxes beakers filled with a magical potion, they conjure up an invite for Spa Day, but MerCat accidentally loses her colour and sparkle
The Smurfs are back and Smurfier than ever! Join these bouncy blue characters as they go on all new adventures and to even greater heights! Smurf we go!
Squidward joins a crew of sailors hunting down the great white jellyfish. Plankton finds a magic bean that takes him to a land of giants (well, more giant than usual).
Plankton becomes a baby food mascot in 'Pablum Plankton', then in 'MuseBob ModelPants', SpongeBob becomes Squidward's muse
The Star Family is a team of superheroes in 'Super Stars', and then in 'Now Museum, Now You Don't', Cecil works security at Lady Upturn's art museum.
A tiny futuristic city exacts revenge on Patrick in 'The Wrath of Shmandor', and then in 'There Goes The Neighbourhood', Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbours.
The family's excited to take Jack to Lake World, Lily's favourite theme park. But when a favourite ride vanishes, the kids must find it and save their holiday. (S1, ep 13)

The wise-cracking blue hedgehog, made famous by a series of popular video games on Sega consoles, continues his computer-animated adventures through the Shatterverse. At the end of the first series, the eponymous spiny mammal (voiced by Deven Mack) learnt from black hedgehog Shadow (Ian Hanlin) that the original version of Green Hill no longer exists. Sonic is trapped in a multiverse of mayhem with different iterations of his friends Amy Rose (Shannon Chan-Kent), Knuckles (Adam Nurada), Rouge (Kazumi Evans) and Tails (Ashleigh Ball). Sonic and Shadow must put aside their differences and work together to repair the temporal damage and outwit diabolical scientist Dr Eggman (Brian Drummond)

With access to the first nationwide survey and state-of-the-art drones mapping the Great Wall of China, this documentary offers new evidence that reveals its extraordinary magnitude, rewrites its millennia-long history and decodes its complex signals system. Using cutting-edge chemistry, the programme also finds out what has kept the wall standing for so long - a simple cooking ingredient found in kitchens across the world

Rome created the largest empire in the ancient world - its armies, organisation and building innovation created a vast territory linked by roads. Many of these cities lie in ruins today, others are buried and many others are forgotten. As this documentary reveals, they include Leptis Magna, Volubilis, Tipasa and Timgad in North Africa and Baalbek, Jerash, Palmyra and Apamea in the Middle East
The rise of Alexander the Great, who became a legend through a series of cruel conquests

Barrister Robert Rinder examines the case of Anthony Richardson, who was attacked in broad daylight outside a shopping centre in Grimsby. CCTV footage helped Humberside Police piece together footage leading up to the incident to discover who was behind the fatal attack. Plus, how teenager Carly Fairhurst's decision to become a prison pen pal to convicted killer Darren Pilkington would change her own life and end in tragedy

Ann Marie Anastasi and husband Anthony had a bizarre domestic arrangement that they both enjoyed - a younger woman, Jacqueline Riggs, lived in their basement and shared their bed. The case of Dr Jim Kohnle, who was found dead in a fire at his family home. Evidence and tip-offs led police to question if it was an accident, suicide or murder

The murder of 37-year-old Rachel Winkler, stabbed in the neck with a pair of scissors by her husband Todd. Neighbours in California described them as 'the perfect family', but despite appearances the couple's marriage had been crumbling, as Rachel had grown tired of her husband's lavish lifestyle and reckless spending

An FBI agent is assigned to protect a witness in the trial of a feared crime boss. However, when they board their flight from Hawaii to Los Angeles, the gangster's henchmen set in motion their plan to smuggle onto the aircraft and then release 450 poisonous snakes. Thriller, starring Samuel L Jackson, Julianna Margulies and Jonathan Phillips

Six federal agents, forced into hiding after a devastating LA terror attack, turn on one another when they begin to suspect the mastermind is one of their own. Thriller, starring Holt McCallany, Hannah John-Kamen and Ethan Embry

When her Florida home town is devastated by a hurricane, Haley heads back into danger to search for her missing father. The pair find themselves trapped in a rapidly flooding house, but the rising waters might be the least of their worries. Horror thriller, starring Kaya Scodelario and Barry Pepper
From Wonder Woman and Indiana Jones to Trolls, expect daring adventures, epic battles and heroes and heroines saving the day

Leonidas, fearless king of Sparta, leads 300 of his finest warriors into battle against the vast invading armies of the ruler of the Persian empire. As the outnumbered Spartans fight for their country, his queen, Gorgo, tries to rally support for her husband at home. Fantasy action adventure based on Frank Miller and Lynn Varley's comic-book series, starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, Dominic West, David Wenham and Rodrigo Santoro

Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

Desperate to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards enters a deadly televised competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Director Edgar Wright's comedy thriller based on the Stephen King story, starring Glen Powell, Lee Pace and Josh Brolin

The shape-changing robots are driven into hiding when the human race turns against them. When rediscovered by a kindly inventor and his daughter, they come out of exile to save the world, battling a new breed of human-created Transformers. These deadly new machines were created to hunt them down, but are now growing independent and intend to make use of technology from the Transformers' home planet in a plot that could threaten all life on Earth. Fourth film in the sci-fi adventure series, starring Mark Wahlberg, Stanley Tucci and Kelsey Grammer

The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell

A clumsy teenager develops superhuman powers after a genetically engineered spider bites him. At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris

Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris

A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Meanwhile, he also has to contend with the challenge of his best friend following in his father's villainous footsteps - and a jealous rival developing superpowers of his own. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

Kal-El, one of the last survivors of the planet Krypton, attempts to protect the people of Earth from evil genius Lex Luthor. Superman is assisted by the Justice Gang, comprising Guy Gardner, aka Green Lantern, Kendra Saunders, aka Hawkgirl, Michael Holt, aka Mister Terrific and Rex Mason, aka Metamorpho. Writer-director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult

The shape-changing robots are driven into hiding when the human race turns against them. When rediscovered by a kindly inventor and his daughter, they come out of exile to save the world, battling a new breed of human-created Transformers. These deadly new machines were created to hunt them down, but are now growing independent and intend to make use of technology from the Transformers' home planet in a plot that could threaten all life on Earth. Fourth film in the sci-fi adventure series, starring Mark Wahlberg, Stanley Tucci and Kelsey Grammer

Bob Garbinger is the money-oriented CEO of a factory that is pumping out dangerous chemicals into the close-knit community of St Roma's Villa. Residents are poisoned by toxins, including widowed janitor Winston Gooze, who works at the factory and learns he has an incurable brain condition. Whistleblower JJ shares devastating information about the factory's reckless disregard for public safety and Winston undergoes a physical transformation in response to exposure to toxic ooze. He takes on the form of a hideously deformed vigilante and wreaks havoc on Bob and his brother Fritz. Comedy horror, starring Peter Dinklage, Kevin Bacon and Taylour Paige

The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell

After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage

A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

With the web-slinger's identity now revealed to the world, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange for magical help to undo the damage. However, a spell gone wrong unleashes dangerous foes from parallel universes on the world. Comic-book adventure sequel, starring Tom Holland, Zendaya and Benedict Cumberbatch, with Willem Dafoe, Jamie Foxx and Alfred Molina among the stars of past Spider-Man movies reprising their roles

Conservationist Sergei Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless father, Nikolai, sets him on a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become Kraven, the world's most feared hunter. Fantasy adventure, starring Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Russell Crowe and Ariana Debose

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa
An Afghanistan veteran comes head to head with her Vietnam vet grandfather at the family's lake house. Comedy drama, starring Sonequa Martin-Green (The Walking Dead), Natalie Morales and Ed Harris
An international action superstar gets involved in a rescue operation of a beloved zoo panda named Hu Hu. Chinese comedy, starring Jackie Chan and Xiang Wei, with subtitles
Giant Panda Hu Hu and an adventurer accidentally stumble into a mysterious primitive tribe, beginning an unprecedented adventure. Action comedy, with Jackie Chan and Li Ma

Arrogant newsreader Ron Burgundy's career is rescued from a drunken slump by an executive for a new 24-hour news channel. Reassembling his team of sidekicks, he swiftly rises from the network's graveyard to become its biggest star with a run of ludicrously sensationalist broadcasts. Comedy sequel, starring Will Ferrell, Christina Applegate, Paul Rudd and Steve Carell

The teenagers reunite after their first year at college to spend the summer at a lake house. Jim is concerned by his lack of sexual experience, and goes in search of an old flame, Oz struggles to keep a long-term relationship going, and Finch tries to master the art of tantric sex. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Biggs, Chris Klein, Seann William Scott, Alyson Hannigan and Eugene Levy

The hapless fool is employed as a security guard for a British art gallery and is sent to Los Angeles to bring back a famous painting. Unfortunately, he finds himself mistaken for a renowned art professor and invited to make an important presentation. Mel Smith's British comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, Burt Reynolds, Peter MacNicol, John Mills, Peter Capaldi and June Brown

The bumbling fool wins first prize in the church raffle - a trip to France and a video camera. His travels cause chaos as he disrupts a film shoot in Cannes, to the fury of its megalomaniac director, and is then accused of kidnapping a youngster. Comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, Willem Dafoe, Emma de Caunes and Max Baldry

The friends from East Great Falls High reunite to celebrate Jim and Michelle's forthcoming wedding. Though reluctant to invite Stifler to their big day, the happy couple relent - but regret their decision when he plans a bachelor party on the same evening Jim is due to meet the in-laws. The third instalment in the comedy series, with Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan, Seann William Scott, Eddie Kaye Thomas and Eugene Levy

An American counter-terrorism unit travels around the world on the lookout for threats to global peace, causing much destruction to major world cities in the process. The biggest current menace is North Korean leader Kim Jong-il and an organisation much closer to home - the Film Actors Guild. Satirical puppet comedy, voiced by South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone

p.t: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
p.d: The half-witted duo meet for the first time as teenagers and band together to face the perils of high school - and prove they are intelligent enough to leave remedial classes behind. Comedy prequel, starring Eric Christian Olsen, Derek Richardson, Rachel Nichols, Eugene Levy and Mimi Rogers
An international action superstar gets involved in a rescue operation of a beloved zoo panda named Hu Hu. Chinese comedy, starring Jackie Chan and Xiang Wei, with subtitles
Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

Dim male model Derek Zoolander is stunned to find his career going downhill thanks to the arrival of an equally vacuous rival - but fails to realise he is merely a pawn in a dangerous game of international espionage and world domination. Comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson, Will Ferrell, Milla Jovovich, Christine Taylor and David Duchovny

An eccentric but brilliant former cop sets himself up to champion the underdog - as a private eye specialising in locating missing animals. The zany detective is called in to find a kidnapped dolphin - the mascot of an American football team - and uncovers a plot involving high-level police corruption. Comedy, starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young, Tone Loc and Noble Willingham

The eccentric pet detective is coaxed out of self-imposed exile in a Buddhist monastery to visit Africa and help search for a sacred white bat. However, his unique investigative talents are tested to the limits as he faces a race against time to find the missing creature and prevent a tribal war. Comedy sequel, starring Jim Carrey, Simon Callow and Bob Gunton

A single man gets the chance to turn his unhappy life around when his father reveals that they both have the ability to travel through time and change their personal history. He uses his newfound talent to try to improve his love life and win the heart of an American woman he has fallen for. Romantic fantasy comedy, with Domhnall Gleeson, Rachel McAdams and Bill Nighy

A farmer is murdered by a hired hand, who flees into the wilderness. The dead man's strong-willed 14-year-old daughter is determined to bring the killer to justice, and recruits the aid of a hard-drinking, one-eyed marshal to help her track him down. The Coen brothers' Western based on Charles Portis' novel, with Jeff Bridges, Hailee Steinfeld, Matt Damon and Josh Brolin

Elton John enters an addiction rehabilitation session, and recounts his life in a flashback, covering his days as young Reginald Dwight growing up in 1950s Britain. He takes piano lessons, makes his way into the Royal Academy of Music, and hones his craft in local pubs before becoming one of the world's biggest pop stars. Golden Globe-winning biopic, starring Taron Egerton, Jamie Bell and Richard Madden

Twenty years after their notorious tabloid romance gripped the nation, a married couple buckles under pressure when an actress arrives to do research for a film about their past. Director Todd Haynes' drama, starring Natalie Portman, Chris Tenzis and Julianne Moore

A manager for an American courier service has to fend for himself when a plane crash leaves him stranded alone on a desert island. Initially panic-stricken, he overcomes his terror to survive for four years on his own before building a raft and setting off on an epic journey back home. Adventure drama, starring Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Nick Searcy, Lari White and Chris Noth

A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

Lightning and Thunder, a Milwaukee husband-and-wife Neil Diamond tribute act, experience soaring success and devastating heartbreak in their musical journey together. Director Craig Brewer's drama, starring Hugh Jackman, an Oscar/Bafta-nominated Kate Hudson, and Ella Anderson

Rebellious American teenager Danny falls for innocent Australian girl Sandy during the summer holidays, but when he later finds out she is a new student at his school, he risks losing her love by trying to act cool in front of his friends. Romantic musical set in the 1950s, starring John Travolta, Olivia Newton-John, Stockard Channing, Jeff Conaway, Didi Conn and Sid Caesar

A shy English boy joins the senior class at Rydell High and immediately falls for the leader of the Pink Ladies. But she is only interested in tough guys, forcing him to adopt a dual identity as a mysterious biker. Musical sequel, starring Michelle Pfeiffer, Maxwell Caulfield, Lorna Luft, Eve Arden and Sid Caesar, with Didi Conn reprising her role as Frenchy from the original film

After a devastating loss, sharp-witted, defiant 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein tells a story that spirals into a dangerous reality. Director Scarlett Johansson's drama, starring June Squibb, Erin Kellyman and Chiwetel Ejiofor

A manager for an American courier service has to fend for himself when a plane crash leaves him stranded alone on a desert island. Initially panic-stricken, he overcomes his terror to survive for four years on his own before building a raft and setting off on an epic journey back home. Adventure drama, starring Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Nick Searcy, Lari White and Chris Noth

A buoy and a satellite meet online and fall in love after the end of human civilisation. Award-winning drama written and directed by Sam Zuchero and Andrew Zuchero, starring Steven Yeun and Kristen Stewart

Ray Stoker and his brother Jem have been estranged for 20 years, haunted by a shared history scarred with violence. Ray now lives in a primitive cabin in the woods in self-imposed exile while Jem has fought refuge in his faith and the love of his partner Nessa and their son Brian. An unexpected family crisis compels Jem to seek out Ray and face the ghosts of the past. Director Ronan Day-Lewis's drama, starring Sean Bean, Daniel Day-Lewis and Samantha Morton

A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

American fashion model-turned-war photographer Lee Miller is determined to document the truth of the Nazi regime, and in spite of the odds stacked against female correspondents, she captures some of the most important images of the Second World War. Fact-based drama, starring Kate Winslet, Andy Samberg, Alexander Skarsgard and Marion Cotillard

A goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity sport dominated by the fiercest animals. Animated adventure, with the voices of Caleb McLaughlin and Gabrielle Union

A criminal mastermind hopes to seal his reputation as the greatest villain of them all by stealing the Moon. First he needs to get his hands on a shrinking ray owned by a rival evil genius, and adopts three orphan girls to help him - but finds that fatherhood brings out his long-buried caring side. Animated comedy, with the voices of Steve Carell, Jason Segel, Russell Brand and Julie Andrews

A reformed criminal mastermind who has abandoned his wicked ways for a life of fatherhood and jam-making helps a secret agent to bring one of his fellow evil geniuses to justice. The villain in question has stolen a dangerous experimental serum with the power to turn harmless animals into ravening monsters. Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig

Dismissed from the Anti-Villain League after botching a mission, Gru sets off to meet his long-lost twin brother for one final criminal mission. Animated sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig, Trey Parker and Miranda Cosgrove

A race of strange, babbling yellow creatures has served the cause of evil throughout the history of the world. In the 1960s, three of these eternal henchmen get a job working for a criminal genius who is hatching a plot against the British crown - but while carrying out her orders, they uncover a threat to their whole species. Animated comedy, with the voices of Sandra Bullock, Pierre Coffin, Jon Hamm and Michael Keaton

A bumbling secret agent becomes Britain's leading spy following the assassination of all the country's other espionage experts. Single-handedly he sets out to unmask a mysterious villain responsible for stealing the Crown Jewels - but no one is prepared to believe a sinister billionaire is the culprit. Comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, John Malkovich, Natalie Imbruglia and Ben Miller

A bumbling secret agent retires to a Tibetan monastery in disgrace after a mission goes wrong. He is lured out of seclusion by the chance to redeem himself when his former bosses seek his help in foiling an attempt to assassinate the premier of China. Spy comedy sequel, starring Rowan Atkinson, Gillian Anderson, Rosamund Pike and Dominic West

A sinister cyber attack reveals the identity of all active undercover agents in Britain. Hapless secret agent Johnny English is sent on a mission to the South of France to protect Queen and country, and find the mastermind hacker responsible. Third movie in the comedy series, starring Rowan Atkinson, Ben Miller and Olga Kurylenko

Shy bridegroom Victor unintentionally gets himself hitched to a ghostly bride, who lures him down into the netherworld. But as he strives to find his way back to the land of the living, a treacherous aristocrat is scheming to marry Victor's flesh-and-blood fiancee. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Johnny Depp, Helena Bonham Carter, Emily Watson, Christopher Lee and Richard E Grant

A teenager discovers his new neighbour is the writer of a popular series of books, who harbours a terrifying secret. The ghosts and monsters the author writes about are real, and his stories keep them contained. The youngster accidentally releases them into the real world, and has to find a way to get them back in the books before they can cause chaos. Fantasy adventure, starring Jack Black and Dylan Minnette
Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey
Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

Ambitious fish Oscar dreams of escaping his humdrum undersea life. His wish comes true when a gangster shark keen to escape a world of organised crime seeks his help in faking his own death. But Oscar soon finds himself out of his depth as his fearsome reputation gets out of control. Animated comedy, with the voices of Will Smith, Robert De Niro, Martin Scorsese, Renee Zellweger, Angelina Jolie and Jack Black

Dracula opens a luxury resort for monsters, to provide a refuge from terrified humans. His cosy sanctuary is disrupted when a normal man unwittingly checks in, and the situation is complicated when the unwanted guest takes a liking to the count's daughter. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg

Dracula is worried that his half-human grandson is not showing any vampiric tendencies, so enlists the help of his fellow monsters in showing the youngster how it is done. The count is shocked to receive an unwelcome visit from his own father, who does not approve of his son's tolerance of humans. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg

Hapless Sonny and his sidekick Sal have a plan to rob a Brooklyn bank. The novice crooks thought they would be in and out in 10 minutes, but instead find themselves stuck in an ongoing hostage situation, with the police and the media laying siege to the bank. Sidney Lumet's fact-based drama, starring Al Pacino, John Cazale and Charles Durning.

A CIA analyst gets caught up in the Colombian drug trade while trying to track down terrorists responsible for the murder of a close friend of the US president - but his investigations point to illegal activity and corruption at the very top of government. Action thriller, based on Tom Clancy's novel, with Harrison Ford reprising his role from Patriot Games alongside Willem Dafoe, Anne Archer and James Earl Jones

A scrupulously honest detective investigates after a cop leaves a suicide note detailing corruption in the force and gangland connections, but gets taken off the case when his own wife is killed by the Mob. However, convinced the officers in charge are covering their tracks, he decides to go it alone. Fritz Lang's noir crime drama, with Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame, Lee Marvin and Alexander Scourby

Vietnam veteran John Rambo is wrongfully arrested in a backwoods town and tested to the limits of his endurance by a brutal deputy. Rambo escapes from his cell and heads out to the woods, and with the forces of the law in hot pursuit he finally has the chance to fight them on his own terms. Action thriller, starring Sylvester Stallone, Brian Dennehy, Richard Crenna and David Caruso

Incarcerated Special Forces veteran John Rambo is offered the chance for freedom by former commander Colonel Trautman if he takes up the offer to return to the jungles of Vietnam on a life-or-death mission to rescue American PoWs. During the course of the operation, he develops strong feelings for his guide, a female freedom fighter - but tragedy strikes, leaving him more determined than ever to exact a bloody and explosive revenge. Action adventure sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Julia Nickson-Soul, Steven Berkoff, George Kee Cheung, Andy Wood and Martin Kove

A New England seaside town's tourist season is turned into a nightmare by a giant killer shark. The local police chief's efforts to protect the public are thwarted by the greedy mayor, forcing him to join forces with a grizzled fisherman and an enthusiastic marine biologist to hunt and kill the monster predator. Steven Spielberg's blockbusting thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Richard Dreyfuss and Robert Shaw, with an Oscar-winning score by John Williams. The film also won Academy Awards for Best Sound and Best Film Editing

The seaside resort of Amity is terrorised once again by a man-eating great white shark. While police chief Brody struggles to alert the townsfolk to the magnitude of the danger, a group of teenagers - including Brody's two sons - is adrift at sea in waters hunted by the shark. Director Jeannot Szwarc's thriller sequel, starring Roy Scheider, Lorraine Gary and Murray Hamilton, with John Williams once more providing the acclaimed score

A shark is captured by divers and put on display in a Florida marine centre, where it ultimately dies. However, examination of the body reveals the seemingly fully-grown shark was actually a baby - and its enormous, ferocious mother soon comes looking for it. Thriller sequel, originally released in cinemas in 3D, starring Dennis Quaid, Simon MacCorkindale, Louis Gossett Jr and Bess Armstrong

A hard-drinking San Francisco cop investigates the case of a man murdered with an ice-pick, but his normally well-honed intuition starts letting him down as he falls for the sultry and manipulative chief suspect, the victim's former girlfriend. Thriller from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Sharon Stone, Michael Douglas, George Dzundza and Jeanne Tripplehorn

A CIA analyst gets caught up in the Colombian drug trade while trying to track down terrorists responsible for the murder of a close friend of the US president - but his investigations point to illegal activity and corruption at the very top of government. Action thriller, based on Tom Clancy's novel, with Harrison Ford reprising his role from Patriot Games alongside Willem Dafoe, Anne Archer and James Earl Jones
This Cinema List is for fear seekers. From The Shining and Weapons to Jaws, brace yourself for relentless tension and terrifying moments that keep you on the edge of your seat

However, convinced the officers in charge are covering their tracks, he decides to go it alone. Fritz Lang's noir crime drama, with Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame, Lee Marvin and Alexander Scourby

Incorruptible federal agent Eliot Ness is assigned the task of fighting organised crime in Prohibition-era Chicago and bringing the notorious crime boss Al Capone to justice. Aware crooked police are undermining his investigations, he puts together his own elite squad to take on the Mob. Brian De Palma's crime thriller, with Kevin Costner, Robert De Niro, Andy Garcia and Sean Connery, who won an Oscar for his performance

The local police chief's efforts to protect the public are thwarted by the greedy mayor, forcing him to join forces with a grizzled fisherman and an enthusiastic marine biologist to hunt and kill the monster predator. Steven Spielberg's blockbusting thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Richard Dreyfuss and Robert Shaw, with an Oscar-winning score by John Williams. The film also won Academy Awards for Best Sound and Best Film Editing

While police chief Brody struggles to alert the townsfolk to the magnitude of the danger, a group of teenagers - including Brody's two sons - is adrift at sea in waters hunted by the shark. Director Jeannot Szwarc's thriller sequel, starring Roy Scheider, Lorraine Gary and Murray Hamilton, with John Williams once more providing the acclaimed score

Trainee crew members of the starship Enterprise embark on their maiden flight, which pits them against a Romulan commander from the future who is planning a horrific revenge on those he blames for a tragedy in his own time. Sci-fi adventure based on the original TV series, starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto, Eric Bana, Zoe Saldana and Leonard Nimoy

Captain Kirk and the crew of the starship Enterprise are sent on a clandestine mission into enemy territory to track down the rogue Starfleet agent behind a terrorist attack on Earth. However, the assignment brings to light a hidden threat from within their own organisation. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch

The USS Enterprise sets out on a rescue mission which turns out to be a deadly trap set by a mysterious warlord. The crew are left stranded on an unexplored planet, and join forces with a fugitive alien scavenger to find a way off the hostile world and prevent a terrible weapon being unleashed upon the galaxy. Sci-fi adventure, starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Idris Elba

A mysterious, planet-sized energy cloud is heading for Earth, destroying everything in its path. Admiral James T Kirk returns to the bridge of the Enterprise to stop the invader, but he has to contend with a bitter rival and the possession of one of his crew by the alien force. Sci-fi adventure, the first movie based on the TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley and Persis Khambatta

p.t: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan (1982)
p.d: The Enterprise crew faces a bitter battle to the death with an old enemy. Khan, a genetically engineered superhuman tyrant, has escaped exile on a barren planet and hijacked a starship to take his revenge on Admiral Kirk, while also scheming to turn an experimental planet-creating device into a doomsday weapon. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban and Kirstie Alley

p.t: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock (1984)
p.d: Admiral Kirk and his crew hijack the decommissioned Enterprise to recover the body of their fallen comrade Mr Spock from the planet Genesis. Kirk has learnt that the science officer's spirit is still alive, and the Vulcan can be resurrected, but he must also battle Kruge, a Klingon captain determined to control the planet's mysterious energy. Sci-fi sequel, directed by Leonard Nimoy, with William Shatner, DeForest Kelley and Christopher Lloyd

p.t: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home (1986)
p.d: The Enterprise crew travels back in time to prevent an alien probe destroying the Earth. The only thing that can avert the disaster is a humpback whale, a creature extinct in the 23rd century - but adjusting to life back in 1986 proves a distinct challenge. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring William Shatner, DeForest Kelley and Leonard Nimoy, who also directed

p.t: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier (1989)
p.d: The Starship Enterprise races to the rescue of intergalactic ambassadors held hostage on a distant planet. The crisis proves to be the handiwork of a renegade Vulcan mystic who kidnaps Captain Kirk and his crew, ordering them to fly to an unexplored world where he hopes to fulfil his insane ambition - to meet God. Sci-fi adventure, written, directed by and starring William Shatner, with Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley and David Warner

A mercenary leads his elite team on a mission to assassinate a South American dictator, only to find their target is merely a pawn and the real power in the country is a rogue CIA agent. Feeling they have been double-crossed, they abandon the operation - but are compelled to return and save a captured rebel. Action thriller, directed by and starring Sylvester Stallone. With Jason Statham and Jet Li

p.t: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country (1991)
p.d: Captain Kirk is framed for the assassination of the Klingon head of state just as the Federation is about to make peace with their old enemies. As Kirk and Dr McCoy are banished to an icy prison planet, Spock tries to uncover the identity of the real killers. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Iman, and Christopher Plummer, with appearances by Christian Slater, and Michael Dorn from Star Trek: The Next Generation

A mysterious, planet-sized energy cloud is heading for Earth, destroying everything in its path. Admiral James T Kirk returns to the bridge of the Enterprise to stop the invader, but he has to contend with a bitter rival and the possession of one of his crew by the alien force. Sci-fi adventure, the first movie based on the TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley and Persis Khambatta

A mercenary leads his elite team on a mission to assassinate a South American dictator, only to find their target is merely a pawn and the real power in the country is a rogue CIA agent. Feeling they have been double-crossed, they abandon the operation - but are compelled to return and save a captured rebel. Action thriller, directed by and starring Sylvester Stallone. With Jason Statham and Jet Li

Mercenary leader Barney Ross is recruited by the CIA to recover a top-secret package, only to come to blows with a rival band of hired guns. Barney swears revenge when the other faction kill his protege, and leads his men on a mission to stop their enemies taking over a former Soviet nuclear facility. Action thriller sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone and Jean-Claude Van Damme

Soldier of fortune Barney Ross discovers an old friend he was forced to kill is still alive, and has become a powerful arms dealer with vengeance on his mind. Barney is forced to recruit a new band of mercenaries and adopt more modern tactics to deal with this threat to him and his past associates. Action thriller sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone and Mel Gibson

A mercenary leads his elite team on a mission to assassinate a South American dictator, only to find their target is merely a pawn and the real power in the country is a rogue CIA agent. Feeling they have been double-crossed, they abandon the operation - but are compelled to return and save a captured rebel. Action thriller, directed by and starring Sylvester Stallone. With Jason Statham and Jet Li

Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman, attempts to fight her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a huge tow bill. Fact-based drama, starring Rose Byrne, Jason Cottle and Elsie Fisher
A young man left broken by the loss of his twin brother joins a support group for 'twinless twins.' Dark comedy, starring Dylan O'Brien and Lauren Graham

The shell-shocked Hamlet learns plans are already afoot for his uncle Claudius to marry his mother Gertrude just days after losing her husband. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

Two small-time crooks kidnap the inventor of a highly intelligent law-enforcement robot. They force him to reprogram the android so it will help them carry out an audacious heist worth $200million, but in doing so, incur the wrath of a ruthless and corrupt general. Sci-fi thriller, starring Sharlto Copley, Hugh Jackman and Dev Patel

A young couple flee the city during a zombie outbreak, only to be involved in a car crash. When the man awakes, his girlfriend is missing, so he bands together with a rugged survivalist to find his partner - but he only has selected memories of what he has been through. Apocalypse drama, starring Carrie-Anne Moss, Douglas Smith, Frank Grillo and Kimberley-Sue Murray

Two astronauts are left stranded in orbit above the Earth when the debris from an exploding satellite destroys their shuttle. Left drifting in space with no way to contact mission control, they begin a perilous journey to reach the safety of a space station before their oxygen supply runs out. Thriller, starring Sandra Bullock and George Clooney

A repairman is assigned to salvage the remaining resources from Earth, which has been left a devastated wasteland after a war with an alien race. He discovers a human survivor on the surface of the planet, an encounter that exposes secrets from the past that threaten the future of the human race. Sci-fi adventure, starring Tom Cruise and Morgan Freeman

Fugitive Riddick evades capture by bounty hunters and steals their spacecraft, only to run into an even bigger threat - fanatical cult members on a sinister mission to kill or convert anyone who crosses their path as they seek galactic domination. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with Vin Diesel reprising his role from Pitch Black alongside Judi Dench, Alexa Davalos and Thandwie Newton.

In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams

A girl is possessed by a formidable demonic entity that resists all efforts at freeing her from its grasp. In desperation, the child's mother appeals for help from a local priest and a veteran exorcist, but succeeding in this nightmarish contest of wills threatens the lives of both men. William Friedkin's horror, starring Linda Blair, Jason Miller, Ellen Burstyn, Max von Sydow and Lee J Cobb

Exorcist John Constantine is cursed with the ability to see spirits stalking the Earth, and grudgingly takes on the forces of evil, hoping his actions will earn him a place in heaven. However, he is told he has terminal cancer and time for salvation is running out - unless a policewoman investigating her twin sister's death can find the key to saving his soul. Supernatural thriller, starring Keanu Reeves, Rachel Weisz and Tilda Swinton

Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland

The shape-changing robots are driven into hiding when the human race turns against them. When rediscovered by a kindly inventor and his daughter, they come out of exile to save the world, battling a new breed of human-created Transformers. These deadly new machines were created to hunt them down, but are now growing independent and intend to make use of technology from the Transformers' home planet in a plot that could threaten all life on Earth. Fourth film in the sci-fi adventure series, starring Mark Wahlberg, Stanley Tucci and Kelsey Grammer

The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell

A clumsy teenager develops superhuman powers after a genetically engineered spider bites him. At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris

Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris

A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Meanwhile, he also has to contend with the challenge of his best friend following in his father's villainous footsteps - and a jealous rival developing superpowers of his own. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco

The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

Kal-El, one of the last survivors of the planet Krypton, attempts to protect the people of Earth from evil genius Lex Luthor. Superman is assisted by the Justice Gang, comprising Guy Gardner, aka Green Lantern, Kendra Saunders, aka Hawkgirl, Michael Holt, aka Mister Terrific and Rex Mason, aka Metamorpho. Writer/director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult

A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

Bob Garbinger is the money-oriented CEO of a factory that is pumping out dangerous chemicals into the close-knit community of St Roma's Villa. Residents are poisoned by toxins, including widowed janitor Winston Gooze, who works at the factory and learns he has an incurable brain condition. Whistleblower JJ shares devastating information about the factory's reckless disregard for public safety and Winston undergoes a physical transformation in response to exposure to toxic ooze. He takes on the form of a hideously deformed vigilante and wreaks havoc on Bob and his brother Fritz. Comedy horror, starring Peter Dinklage, Kevin Bacon and Taylour Paige

Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Elizabeth Banks and Will Arnett
